tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open paid AI training jobs (AI tutor, trainer, rater, evaluator, annotator, voice work) listed on aitrainers.jobs, by country, kind of work, language, minimum hourly pay and experience. Returns each role with its pay, where it is open and a link to its page on aitrainers.jobs.

tools.name: job_counts
tools.description: How many open AI training jobs aitrainers.jobs lists, by kind of work and by platform, optionally for one country.
